name: covexcode-agent
description: Chat with covexcode, driven over its ACP stdio interface.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Chat stays available in Restricted Mode. covexcode will not read, write, or run commands until this folder is trusted.

chatParticipants.name: covexcode
chatParticipants.description: Ask covexcode to read, write, and run things in this workspace.

commands.name: provider
commands.description: Pick a provider, model, and API key (same as the covexcode CLI /provider flow).

commands.name: model
commands.description: Switch model for the current provider without changing the API key.

commands.title: covexcode: Change Provider / Model / API Key

covexcode.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `covexcode` CLI binary, if it isn't on the PATH this app was launched with. Leave empty to resolve `covexcode` off PATH, then `~/.local/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, `~/.cargo/bin`, and `~/.covexcode/bin` (the locations `install.sh` actually writes to, which a Finder-launched app's PATH often misses).

covexcode.provider.markdownDescription: LLM provider registry id (e.g. `deepseek`), or empty for a custom endpoint. Prefer **Sign In to covexcode.com** (Accounts / profile menu), chat `/provider`, or [Change Provider / Model / API Key](command:covexcode.changeProvider).

covexcode.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL for covexcode's OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (e.g. `https://api.deepseek.com` or `https://llm.covexcode.com/v1`). Set automatically by Sign In / `/provider`; leave empty to use `~/.covexcode/config.toml` from the CLI when no IDE override is stored.

covexcode.model.markdownDescription: Model name for the configured provider/endpoint. Use chat `/model` to pick from the provider's list, `/provider` to change provider + model + key, or [Change Provider / Model / API Key](command:covexcode.changeProvider).

covexcode.apiKey.markdownDescription: API keys are stored in the OS secure store (never in `settings.json`). Prefer [Sign In to covexcode.com](command:covexcode.signIn), [Set API Key](command:covexcode.setApiKey), or [Change Provider / Model / API Key](command:covexcode.changeProvider).

covexcode.costPerMillionTokens.markdownDescription: Blended USD price per million tokens, used for the `~$` estimate in the chat usage footnote. Defaults to a blended DeepSeek input+output estimate; set to 0 to show token totals only. The authoritative per-model figure should come from covexcode itself (see `docs/BACKLOG.md`, cost/usage meter).
